_provenance: Shorebird phylogeny and traits from the R package caper (github.com/davidorme/caper, data/shorebird.rda): shorebird.tree, an ape phylo with 71 tips and 62 internal nodes, and shorebird.data, 71 species x (Species, M.Mass, F.Mass, Egg.Mass, Cl.size, Mat.syst). Traits from Lislevand & Thomas, 'Limited male incubation ability and the evolution of egg size in shorebirds' (Biology Letters, 2006/2007). Model mirrored: the caper vignette's simple PGLS pgls(log(Egg.Mass) ~ log(M.Mass), shorebird) at the default lambda=1 (Brownian motion), so C is the plain phylogenetic variance-covariance of the tree and is fixed data. C[i,j] = root-to-MRCA path length, computed by converting ape's (edge, edge.length) to Newick and running it through the Newick parser of models/phylo_pois.py, cross-checked against a direct edge-matrix computation (max abs diff 0); then divided by the root-to-tip depth so diag(C) = 1. Nothing is simulated: y = log(Egg.Mass) and X = [1, log(M.Mass)] are the recorded traits. Built by benchmark/probprog/ablation/sicm_roster/build_shorebird_pgls.py.
